stage0085a_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So, this is the space between dimensions...」

stage0085a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$n
「If I let my guard down even a little,
　I'll be swallowed up by this current...!」

stage0085a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$シュレード$$
「The groan of warped space... a dissonance of despair...
　At this rate, we too, will eventually...」

stage0085a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$カイエン$$
「How is it, $$シュレード$$!
　Have you found anything yet...!」

stage0085a_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アルト$$
「We'll activate the Fold Wave System too!
　It should help, at least a bit!」

stage0085a_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$クラン$$
（Catching $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s voices,
　and tracing a route to the world of Altair
　from the flow of that sound...）

stage0085a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ルカ$$
（No matter how much the YF-29's
　Fold Wave System might help...）

stage0085a_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（But for now, all we can do is bet on $$シュレード$$）

stage0085a_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ガムリン$$
（Is he trying to burn away
　what little life he has left, here...）

stage0085a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Anomaly in the dimensional boundary!
　Something's appearing in this space!」

stage0085a_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's a $$ケルビム兵$$ under $$ミカゲ$$'s command!」

stage0085a_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$タケル$$
「You're trying to stop us from reaching Altair!」

stage0085a_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$シュレード$$...!
　We'll take down the enemy!」

stage0085a_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$刹那$$
「...I don't understand what a song is...
　But I understand this much: that it carries
　someone's feelings」

stage0085a_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$刹那$$
「We'll protect you, the one who can receive it!」

stage0085a_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$桂$$
「$$刹那$$'s right!
　It might get a bit noisy,
　but listen close!」

stage0085a_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アルト$$, I'm leaving $$シュレード$$'s escort to you」

stage0085a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... what a good life...」

stage0085a_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That I, who killed with music,
　could save people... the world, with music...
　I want to answer everyone's... the world's wish...」

stage0085a_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I feel the same, $$シュレード$$」

stage0085a_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Little by little, I can hear the flow of sound...」

stage0085a_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$シュレード$$
「If we reach that point, it'll be clearer」

stage0085a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アルト$$
「Understood, $$シュレード$$!
　Heading for that position!」

stage0085a_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, cover $$シュレード$$ and $$アルト$$!
　Don't let that skeleton get close!」

stage0085a_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I'm going, Chairwoman $$クレア$$」

stage0085a_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$シュレード$$!
　Not in that weakened body...!」

stage0085a_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Even so, I'll go on」

stage0085a_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$シュレード$$
「The ultimate melody I seek...
　It is... life's sound」

stage0085a_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Surely, it shines brightest at the very edge...
　Just as everyone of $c fights, risking their lives,
　and seizes victory...」

stage0085a_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シュレード$$
「So I will burn this life away...!
　For the proof that I lived...
　to complete the ultimate melody!」

stage0085a_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アンディ$$
「H-hey!
　At this rate we won't be able to hear
　$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s song!」

stage0085a_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「It's fine.
　$$バサラ$$'s sound... the power of life, melds
　with mine, and seeks $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s sound...」

stage0085a_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Your wish... we'll all protect it together!」

stage0085a_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$シュレード$$...
　Let me hear it too, your ultimate melody」

stage0085a_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I promise, Chairwoman $$クレア$$」

stage0085a_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$シュレード$$
「$$アルト$$!
　The Fold Wave System!」

stage0085a_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$シュレード$$
「What a long way around...
　The scales of two stars overlap,
　becoming pure white light...」

stage0085a_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That's the blank space in one's own heart...
　Or perhaps a new world...!
　Just like a pure white musical staff...!」

stage0085a_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シュレード$$
「This is the last melody I found...!
　The true music of Aquarion, born from nothing...!
　Yes, the song of the beginning!」

stage0085a_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シュレード$$
「To live is to carve a mark.
　I'll play life, carve it deep,
　and cut open the path ahead of you...!」

stage0085a_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Now, my feelings are overflowing!」

stage0085a_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s feelings...」

stage0085a_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, advance!
　Don't let $$シュレード$$'s life go to waste!」

stage0085a_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シュレード$$
（...Something like this... I never
　would have dreamed of before...
　Playing my life for someone else...）

stage0085a_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Your life can't be over yet!!」

stage0085a_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シュレード$$
（I will... live... forever...
　in this... space between dimensions...
　together with the sound of every dimension...）

stage0085a_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$シュレード$$
（All sound harmonizes into one melody...
　My life... comes along, too.........）

stage0085a_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シュレード$$
（This is farewell, my friend...）

stage0085a_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$シュレード$$
（Did it reach... my...... melody.........）

stage0085a_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シュレード$$
（My life will run out soon...）

stage0085a_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シュレード$$
（But before that, I'll find it...!
　The ultimate melody... the song of life!）
